entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-08-18
entry.content:
Google.Maps.MapManagement.V2 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Maps.MapManagement.V2

Google.Cloud.WorkloadIdentity.V1 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.WorkloadIdentity.V1

Google.Cloud.Ftp.V1 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.Ftp.V1

Google.DevicesAndServices.Health.V4 version 1.0.0-beta03

New features

  • Add menstrual cycle, symptoms, and mood data types to Health API v4
  • Expand ExerciseType enum with comprehensive activity categories
  • Add granular OAuth scopes and per-method authorization mappings

Bug fixes

  • An existing packaging option google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/devicesandservices/health/apiv4main;healthpb for go_package is removed
  • A new packaging option google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/devicesandservices/health/apiv4;healthpb for go_package is added

Documentation improvements

  • Improve documentation for data_source_family and window_size parameters
  • Update webhook signature header name to GOOGLE-HEALTH-API-SIGNATURE

Google.Cloud.VectorSearch.V1 version 1.1.0

New features

  • Add VertexRanker reranker support to vector search

Google.Cloud.AuditManager.V1 version 1.2.0

New features

  • Add organizations level support for GenerateAuditScopeReport, GenerateAuditReport and GetAuditReport
  • Add validate_only field to GenerateAuditReportRequest
  • Deprecated the old compliance_standard field in favour of compliance_framework for GenerateAuditScopeReport and GenerateAuditReport
  • Add https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-auditmanager OAuth scope

Documentation improvements

  • Update documentation for validate_only
  • Clarify documentation for several RPCs, resource messages, and enumerations

Google.Cloud.Dataform.V1 version 1.1.0

New features

  • Add output-only field lineage_enabled to message .google.cloud.dataform.v1.WorkflowInvocation

Google.Cloud.Spanner version 5.13.0-beta09

New features

  • Add support for Protobuf Enums

Google.Cloud.Storage.Control.V2 version 1.10.0

New features

  • Add ViewObjectFullContext RPC and RapidCacheInfo in Storage Control v2
